# Calisthenics Lab India

> Calisthenics academy in Kondapur, Hyderabad, near HITEC City, Gachibowli and Madhapur. Adult calisthenics group batches (beginner to advanced, including weekends), personal coaching, a kids calisthenics, gymnastics & parkour program (ages 3–15), and yoga at The Yog Lab.

## Fees
- Weekday batches: ₹7,777/month, ₹22,222 for 3 months, ₹44,444 for 6 months, ₹77,777 for a year
- Weekend batches: ₹5,555/month (1.5-hour slots), ₹4,444/month (1-hour slots)
- Kids (The Mighty Tribe, ages 3–15): ₹5,555/month
- Demo: free on weekdays; weekend demo ₹800, adjusted in the package on joining
- Sister academy: Indian Calisthenics School, Madhapur (https://www.indiancalisthenicsschool.com/)

## Location & contact

- Address: Kondapur Road, Kondapur, New Hafeezpet, Raghavendra Colony, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana 500084, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 88267 62234
- Email: Calisthenicslabindia@gmail.com
- Calisthenics hours: Monday–Friday 6:30–9:30 AM and 6:00–9:00 PM; Saturday–Sunday 8:30–11:00 AM and 5:30–8:00 PM
- [Google Maps](https://maps.app.goo.gl/695SVZHotKEeK4zJ7) · [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/calisthenics.lab.india)

Yoga Abhyas group class (Monday, Wednesday and Friday, 6:30–7:30 and 7:30–8:30 AM) ₹6,666/month for 3 days a week; Yoga Sankalp 1-on-1 personal training (posture correction, PCOD / PCOS support, personal goals) ₹11,111/month for 2 sessions a week

## Skills taught

Pull-ups, push-ups, dips, handstands, L-sit, muscle-ups and levers.
